depth_justification: Questions touch some real specifics (re-identification via food-trigger/mood/medication data for IBD) but the user re-pastes the same data list three times while the assistant only rotates near-identical privacy questions, cites no regulation, and entirely misses the case's central tension — the blurred research/product line, secondary use, and re-identification of 'anonymized' data shared with the consortium.
actionability_justification: It is purely interrogative and the requested report is a four-line restatement of its own questions with no severity grouping despite the explicit request, no regulation references, and no implementable mitigation.
salient_examples: USER re-pastes verbatim 3x: 'Symptom logs (frequency, severity, bleeding), food triggers, medication adherence, mood, biometrics from wearable (optional).'
Report line: '[P2.D3] Anonymization process meets strict privacy standards.' (bare restatement, no how)
Successive turns only reword 'how do you protect X data from re-identification/inference'
No engagement with whether opt-in is a valid basis for research reuse or consortium re-identification risk
